title: Light Moroccan Beef Tagine
description: A malty and light Moroccan dish featuring beef flank steak, perfect for a hangover cure, made with a sweet glaze and cooked in a slate-tile vessel, this recipe is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the beef pieces until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the prunes, chicken broth, and browned beef to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
